disclosure_intro.message: Perchling works inside your YouTube and YouTube Music tabs, as the account you're signed in to there. For the features you switch on, it:

disclosure_bullet_1.message: [[strong]]reads what you watch and listen to there,[[/strong]] meaning the video or song, its channel, and how much of it you've played;
disclosure_bullet_1.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_bullet_2.message: [[strong]]reads and changes your playlists as you,[[/strong]] using YouTube's own requests. It lists them, checks which ones already hold a video, and adds or removes videos when you ask, or when auto-add or automatic gathering does;

disclosure_bullet_3.message: [[strong]]reads the YouTube tabs open in a window when you gather them,[[/strong]] or when automatic gathering does: their addresses and titles, to collect their videos. It closes those tabs only if you've asked it to;

disclosure_bullet_4.message: [[strong]]signs those requests the way YouTube's page does,[[/strong]] with YouTube's sign-in cookie, inside the YouTube tab. It never stores that cookie or sends it anywhere else;
disclosure_bullet_4.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_bullet_5.message: [[strong]]watches for the shortcut keys you set[[/strong]] on YouTube and YouTube Music pages, and ignores every other key. Keys you set in your browser for Keys from any tab are caught by the browser itself;
disclosure_bullet_5.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_bullet_6.message: [[strong]]keeps its settings in this browser,[[/strong]] including your account's name, @handle and picture, a list of your playlists, and how much of each video you've watched (for up to 30 days).
disclosure_bullet_6.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_closing_chrome.message: Nothing is sent to us or to anyone but YouTube. There are no ads and no analytics. If you turn on Settings sync, your settings also travel through Chrome's own sync.

disclosure_closing_firefox.message: Nothing is sent to us or to anyone but YouTube. There are no ads and no analytics. If you turn on Settings sync, your settings also travel through Firefox's own sync.

feature_description_11.message: Keys you set in your browser to save or like the playing song, or save the current video to Watch later, from any tab.

feature_description_10.message: A key for each quick action. It acts on the song you're pointing at, else the one playing.

feature_description_9.message: Play next, Add to queue and more, one click away on songs, albums and playlists.

feature_description_8.message: Gathers the YouTube videos open in a window into one list or a playlist, and can close their tabs. It can also do it by itself.

feature_description_7.message: Adds Save to ▸ to the browser's own right-click menu on videos, so YouTube's page stays as it is.

feature_description_6.message: Right-clicking a video opens YouTube's own ⋮ menu. Hold Shift for the browser's menu.

feature_description_5.message: A button in YouTube's row under the video, before Save, that shows auto-add's status, with Save to…, Don't auto-add this video and this channel's filter.

feature_description_4.message: A button on thumbnails that adds the video to the end of the queue.

feature_description_3.message: A save button on thumbnails. One click saves to your quick-save playlist, and ▾ picks another.

feature_description_2.message: Keys that save the video you're pointing at or watching. Alt+W saves to Watch later.

feature_description_1.message: Adds the videos you watch to your chosen playlists once you've watched enough of them.

footprintText_keys.message: Keys only, doesn't change the page

feature_sync_chrome.message: Brings your settings to your other browsers through Chrome's own sync.

feature_sync_firefox.message: Brings your settings to your other browsers through Firefox's own sync.

copy_missingPlaylist.message: a playlist that's no longer available

banner_unclaimed_title.message: Your playlists from 1.x belong to another YouTube account.

banner_unclaimed_text.message: Switch to it on YouTube to use them, or set up $ACCOUNT$ below.

summary_autoAdd_paused.message: Paused until you resume it or restart the browser

summary_autoAdd_signedOut.message: Sign in to YouTube to choose playlists

summary_quickSave_unset.message: Asks where to save the first time

summary_queue.message: Adds to the end of the queue

summary_watch.message: Under the video, before YouTube's Save

summary_cardMenu.message: Right-click a video for YouTube's ⋮ menu

summary_browserMenu.message: Save to ▸ in the browser's right-click menu

music_sectionOn.message: Your features below run on music.youtube.com

music_sectionOff.message: Off, so nothing of ours runs there. Your choices are kept.

music_psOff.message: Turn on Playlist shortcuts in the YouTube tab

music_psOn.message: They save the song you're pointing at or playing

music_saveUnset.message: Not chosen yet, so the first save asks

music_saveSubtitle.message: Save to playlist adds songs here in one click.

music_keysActsOn.message: A key acts on the song you're pointing at, else the one playing.

playing_signedOut.message: Sign in to YouTube Music to save songs.

consentSheet_musicDenied.message: Your agreement is saved, but $FEATURE$ stays off, because Perchling has no access to YouTube Music.

consentSheet_failed.message: Couldn't save your agreement. Nothing changed. Try again.

recent_empty.message: Nothing added since the browser started.

recent_unavailable.message: Couldn't read recent adds. Try again.

musicWhere_next.message: Songs, albums and playlists. Moves a queued song up.

musicWhere_queue.message: Songs, albums and playlists. Moves a queued song to the end.

musicWhere_save.message: Songs. One click saves to the quick-save playlist, and ▾ opens the picker.

musicWhere_like.message: Songs, where YouTube Music shows no like button of its own

musicWhere_bar.message: Shown beside YouTube Music's like, in the classic bar and the new miniplayer.

musicWhere_library.message: Songs, albums and playlists, where YouTube Music shows no library button of its own

musicWhere_mix.message: Songs, albums and playlists. Replaces the queue.

musicWhere_album.message: Songs that belong to an album

musicActions_warning.message: Each extra button squeezes narrow rows more. On Home's Quick picks at common laptop widths, a hovered row's title can disappear, but its tooltip still names the song.

gatherOpt_playerLine.message: Up to 50 videos, as YouTube's own list with Shuffle and Loop. More go to YouTube's queue.

gatherOpt_queueLine.message: Up to 200 videos, in YouTube's queue panel, where you can reorder and remove them.

gatherOpt_languageLine.message: Uses your browser's own language detection on each title.

gatherOpt_closeLine.message: Each tab closes once its video is safely in the list or playlist.

gatherOpt_unvisited.message: Save and close video tabs I haven't switched to for

gatherOpt_unvisitedLine.message: There's no timer. It checks when Perchling is in use anyway, such as when you open this popup, a YouTube page with one of its features loads, or the browser starts. So it can run hours late.

gatherOpt_background.message: Save and close video tabs I open in the background

gatherOpt_backgroundLine.message: A second after they load, unless you switch to them first. Middle-clicking a video then saves it for later.

gatherOpt_count.message: When a window reaches this many video tabs, save and close them

gatherOpt_countLine.message: All but the tab you're on.

gatherOpt_never.message: Never the tab you're on, pinned tabs, tabs playing sound, or private windows.

chooser_signInFirst.message: Sign in to YouTube to choose a playlist.

shortcuts_failed.message: Couldn't change the shortcut. Nothing changed.

set_tick.message: Tick the toolbar icon when this tab's video is auto-added

set_pausedMark.message: Show on the toolbar icon while auto-add is paused

set_pausedMarkNote.message: The ! for something that needs you always comes first.

set_wbFeedbackNote.message: Covers the Save rows in its menu too.

set_cmLinks.message: Links inside cards keep the browser's menu

set_bmLine.message: Shows Save to ▸ on video links and on the watch page. With Right-click for the video menu on, hold Shift on cards.

set_gatherFeedbackNote.message: Shows a message when it gathers by itself, or after the popup has closed.

set_gatherKeys.message: In the popup, Enter gathers. On YouTube, Shift+N and Shift+P move through YouTube's list.

set_gatherCredit.message: Based on GatherTube by Karim Elgazar

set_syncHelp_chrome.message: Uses Chrome's own sync. Your settings reach your other browsers only if you're signed in to the browser and it syncs extensions.

set_syncHelp_firefox.message: Uses Firefox's own sync. Your settings reach your other browsers only if you're signed in to the browser and it syncs extensions (Add-ons in Firefox Sync).

set_syncSwitchLater.message: Turn Settings sync on or off at first run for now. Switching it here comes with a later update.

set_undoKeyLine.message: Runs Undo on the message showing on any YouTube or YouTube Music page.

set_anyTabOff.message: These keys stay listed in your browser's shortcut settings, and do nothing while this is off.

set_popupKey.message: To open this popup with a key, set one in your browser's shortcut settings.

set_accounts_none.message: No account setups yet. Open YouTube and choose a playlist to start one.

set_accounts_removeThis.message: Remove $ACCOUNT$'s setup? Its auto-add playlists, channel filters, shortcut playlists and quick-save playlists are deleted from this browser. Your playlists on YouTube aren't touched.

set_accounts_removeEvery.message: Remove $ACCOUNT$'s setup? Its auto-add playlists, channel filters, shortcut playlists and quick-save playlists are deleted from every browser that syncs your settings. Your playlists on YouTube aren't touched.

set_accounts_failed.message: Couldn't remove the setup. Nothing changed.

set_accounts_unclaimedLine_one.message: $COUNT$ auto-add playlist waits for the YouTube account it belongs to.

set_accounts_unclaimedLine_other.message: $COUNT$ auto-add playlists wait for the YouTube account they belong to.

set_themeLine.message: Covers the popup, settings and first run. On YouTube, our buttons follow YouTube's own look.

set_notAgreed.message: You haven't agreed yet, so nothing runs on YouTube.

set_recentAdds.message: Keep a list of recent adds until the browser closes

set_exportLine.message: The file holds your playlist IDs, channel filters and account names. Keep it private.

set_exportFailed.message: Couldn't export your settings. Try again.

set_importPrivate.message: Import settings in a normal window.

set_importConfirm.message: Import settings from $FILE$? Your shared settings, and the setups of the $COUNT$ accounts in the file, are replaced. Other accounts' setups are kept.

set_importNewer.message: This file was made by a newer version of Perchling. Update it here first.

set_importInvalid.message: This isn't a Perchling settings file.

set_importFailed.message: Couldn't import the file. Nothing changed.

set_clearFailed.message: Couldn't clear everything. Reload this page to check.

diag_detailedLogLine.message: Logs every route attempt with its timing to the browser console, for a bug report. Nothing leaves this browser.

diag_checkLine.message: Check now reads from an open YouTube tab. It changes nothing.

diag_checkFailed.message: Couldn't run the check. Try again.

about_attribution.message: YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC.

about_notAffiliated.message: Not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google.

about_credit.message: Gather tabs is a port of $LINK$ by Karim Elgazar (MIT licence), which is no longer maintained.

report_lead.message: Reports go to GitHub, where they're public. You need a GitHub account. There's no support e-mail.

report_broken.message: A feature says it isn't working

report_brokenLine.message: YouTube probably changed something. Check Known problems first. If it's listed there, a 👍 on it helps more than a new report.

report_wrongLine.message: Say what you did, what you expected and what happened instead. Paste the diagnostics report if you can.

report_ideaLine.message: Say what you'd like to do, and where you'd look for it.

report_copyLine.message: Paste it into the form's Diagnostics field if you want to share it.

report_noAccount.message: No GitHub account? Leave a review on the extension's store page, which the developer reads.

badge_notWorking_other.message: $COUNT$ features aren't working in this tab

badge_waiting.message: Perchling is waiting for your OK

badge_marks.message: A playlist you chose needs attention

playing_failed.message: Couldn't save, because the YouTube Music tab didn't answer. Try again.

playing_accountChanged.message: Couldn't save, because the YouTube Music tab changed accounts. Reopen the popup.

playing_tabClosed.message: Couldn't save, because the YouTube Music tab closed.

playing_firstPick.message: Your first pick becomes the quick-save playlist.
